text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since getting her racewear, Copano 
Rickey had been in great shape and 
well-received by fans. When I told her 
that—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Rickey☆ Lucky☆ It worked like a 
charm!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The one on my racing outfit, of course! 
That outfit was designed using feng shui 
to draw in tons of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For example, the main colors of the outfit 
are the "Joyful" yellow that invites good 
fortune and red that boosts winning luck.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
On my hip are four petals to bring good 
fortune. Thanks to this accessory weaving 
connections, I feel like my fanbase is 
growing♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Other than that, I also painted my nails 
light blue to ward off negative qi—
choice_data_list:
You're really particular about this, 
aren't you?

You really care about the details, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If I win in a Racewear designed 
around feng shui, people will get 
interested in feng shui too, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it might help clear up some of 
the public's misunderstandings about feng 
shui, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is an environmental statistical 
science based on theory and calculation to 
guide people to happiness. Yet, the public 
image of it is completely the opposite, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Suspicious," "fake," "shady"— at worst, 
people even treat me like a scammer.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Though usually, that's just because people 
are doing it wrong, or they quit right 
before seeing any results.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because of that misunderstanding, the 
people who tried Feng Shui and Feng Shui 
practitioners like Papa were all left 
unhappy. That always made me so sad...

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Feng shui is a 'field of study' 
meant to bring happiness! Even though 
everyone just wants to be happy~!

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Papa. I'm gonna do it! I'll teach the 
whole world true feng shui and make 
everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Rickey's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It might take some time, but... I 
know you can do it, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna teach everyone more about 
feng shui and make everybody happy...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—After that, I got even more into feng 
shui. I devoured specialized books and 
tried out methods from all sorts of 
schools.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's all for everyone's happiness...!
choice_data_list: Then we'd better win a whole lot of races!
Then we'd better win a whole lot of races!
Your dad will be happy too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's all for everyone's happiness...!
choice_data_list: Then we'd better win a whole lot of races!
Then we'd better win a whole lot of races!
Your dad will be happy too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And for that, first we need solid 
training! Right!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So here's my suggestion— why don't we 
incorporate more feng shui into the new 
menu?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Soaking up the morning sun boosts your 
energy, so moving indoor training to the 
afternoon, or—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The 'Metal' in the Five Elements also 
relates to muscle fibers, so doing 
strength training in the west where Metal 
energy is boosted, or—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of other useful feng shui 
tips too! What do you think?
choice_data_list: Got it, tell me more in detail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Copano Rickey stack effort upon 
effort toward her dream, I listened 
closely to what she had to say so I could 
firmly support her.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I sure hope so~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Papa tells me, 'If you ever find 
something you want to do besides feng 
shui, you're free to pursue it.'

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, what I want to do is feng shui! 
The direction of my dreams has already 
been set!”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Besides, Papa looked so happy when he was 
talking about feng shui with me, and Mama 
looked so happy watching Papa.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just watching the two of them made me feel 
happy, too...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Five Elements, happiness 
circulates too! I believe that as Feng 
Shui spreads, the circle of happiness will 
spread along with it...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's spread a cycle of happiness 
all across the world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Copano Rickey forge ahead toward 
her dream, I renewed my determination to 
firmly support her.
